locked.promptVariant: Pokémon FireRed/LeafGreen GBA overworld phrasing, 'flat roofs seen from above with front walls as a flat band under the roof, the way Pallet Town houses are drawn'; same scene and palette block as C
locked.fullPrompt: Pixel art game screenshot, 16-bit style, top-down 3/4 perspective like an RPG Maker or Stardew Valley town street, crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no dithering, clean 1-pixel dark outlines on every object. Scene: a real Bangalore, India residential lane at morning. Left: a narrow 3-storey independent house, exposed red brick and cream plaster, iron grille balconies, a black Sintex water tank on the flat roof, a tangle of overhead electric cables. Centre: a small "Darshini" standing eatery with a steel counter, a painted red-and-yellow signboard reading HOTEL DARSHINI, steel tumblers and an idli steamer, two plastic stools. Right: a provision store with sachets hanging in strips and a blue plastic drum. Foreground: a tar road with patch repairs and a white speed breaker, a black-and-yellow auto rickshaw parked, a broken paver-block footpath, a rain tree with leaf litter, a green BBMP dustbin, a stray dog. Characters: two Indian pedestrians in chibi proportions (big head, small body, about 1 tile wide and 1.5 tiles tall), a young man in a light-blue formal shirt with a backpack and a young woman in a kurti with a sling bag, both with clean 1px dark outlines, wheatish skin. Palette: warm, slightly desaturated earth tones — brick red, cream, ochre, tar grey, rain-tree green, auto yellow — soft warm shadows, morning haze, a limited palette of about 48 colours. Everything grid-aligned to 32-pixel tiles. No text except the Darshini board, no real brand logos, no watermark, no UI.
